findings.message: Camunda 8 has no per-process history time to live (was "P30D").
findings.suggestion: Configure data retention for the cluster (Operate, Tasklist and Optimize archiving).

findings.message: Camunda 8 does not restrict who may start a process in the model.
findings.suggestion: Grant CREATE_PROCESS_INSTANCE on the process definition through authorizations.

findings.message: Implemented as a Camunda user task (zeebe:userTask).
findings.suggestion: zeebe:userTask

findings.message: candidateUsers expression became "=assessors". Camunda 7 accepted a comma-separated string or a collection here; Camunda 8 requires a list of strings.
findings.suggestion: Make sure the expression evaluates to a list of strings.

findings.message: Form key "embedded:app:forms/assess-claim.html" became a custom form reference (zeebe:formDefinition externalReference).
findings.suggestion: Tasklist does not render embedded HTML forms: rebuild it as a Camunda Form, or serve it from a custom task application that reads externalReference.

findings.message: Extension properties moved to zeebe:properties.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:properties

findings.message: Field injection "threshold" became a task header.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskHeaders — read it from the job's custom headers.

findings.message: Field injection "region" is an expression evaluated by the engine.
findings.suggestion: Map the value with an input mapping and read it as a job variable.

findings.message: Java delegate class "com.acme.claims.FraudCheckDelegate" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "fraudCheckDelegate" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "class" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).

findings.message: Multi-instance over "${claim.items}" became zeebe:loopCharacteristics inputCollection="=claim.items" inputElement="item".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:loopCharacteristics

findings.message: Completion condition became "=numberOfCompletedInstances / numberOfInstances >= 0.6" (nrOf… variables renamed to numberOf…).
findings.suggestion: FEEL completion condition

findings.message: FEEL script became zeebe:script, result in "itemPrice".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:script

findings.message: Camunda 7 connector "http-connector" has no Camunda 8 equivalent with the same inputs.
findings.suggestion: Use the Camunda 8 REST connector (io.camunda:http-json:1) and map its inputs.

findings.message: Input parameter "note" was not converted: text mixed with ${…} is string templating, which FEEL does not do implicitly.
findings.suggestion: Write it as <zeebe:input source="=…" target="note"/> by hand.

findings.message: Input parameter "audit" was not converted: it is a groovy script.
findings.suggestion: Write it as <zeebe:input source="=…" target="audit"/> by hand.

findings.message: 2 input/output parameters moved to zeebe:ioMapping, JUEL translated to FEEL.
findings.suggestion: zeebe:ioMapping

findings.message: External task topic "notify-claimant" became job type "notify-claimant".
findings.suggestion: zeebe:taskDefinition type — point the external task worker at the Camunda 8 job API with the same type.

findings.message: Execution listener on "end" (javascript script) runs Java or script code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement it as a job worker and declare it with zeebe:executionListeners (eventType="end", type="<job type>").

findings.message: Execution platform set to Camunda Cloud 8.10.0 (was Camunda Platform).
findings.suggestion: Camunda Modeler opens the file as a Camunda 8 diagram.

findings.message: Placeholder jobType "placeholder-Task_payout" written so the model deploys (zeebe/service-task-definition).
findings.suggestion: Replace it with the real value; the placeholder does nothing useful at runtime.
